subject: general
question: What is one of the key principles recently outlined by India to boost economic ties with the European Union?

options.text: Develop resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.
Increase reliance on non-market economies for raw materials.
Expand trade by focusing on low-cost production methods.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Develop resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal outlined a six-point plan to enhance economic ties with the European Union (EU) during a meeting with Maros Sefcovic, European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, on January 18-19, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India and the EU agreed on mutual collaboration to build resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.**
 
• India aims to harmonize standards with the EU for "zero defect" and "zero effect" production capabilities.
 
• A roadmap for addressing tariff and non-tariff barriers was laid to benefit businesses, farmers, and fishermen on both sides.
 
• Both parties plan to expedite the establishment of a robust Free Trade Agreement (FTA) to address global challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Six-Point Plan Highlights__

 __
 
• Strengthen a fair and equitable trade agenda by addressing tariff and non-tariff barriers.
 
• Promote sustainable development while considering levels of development and shared responsibility.
 
• Enhance technology exchanges to build cutting-edge solutions and foster economic collaboration.
 
 
 
• India-EU Trade and Technology Council (TTC)__
 __
 
• A platform for dialogue on trade, investment, and technology cooperation between India and the EU.
 
• Focuses on reducing dependencies on non-market economies and improving global competitiveness.
 
 
 
• India-EU Relations__
 
 
• India and the EU together represent a market worth over $24 trillion and a population of approximately 2 billion people.
 
• The collaboration aligns with shared democratic values, the rule of law, and aspirations for economic growth.
